title: Dynamics of Heavy Operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM: Integrated Correlators and AdS Bubbles
summary: We study integrated correlation functions of half-BPS operators in $SU(N)$ $\mathcal{N} = 4$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory (SYM) involving two superconformal primary operators in the stress-tensor multiplet and two identical maximal-trace operators of arbitrary $R$-charge $p$. Thanks to $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM electro-magnetic duality these integrated correlators have recently been computed as exact functions of $N$, $p$, and of the Yang-Mills complexified coupling $τ$.
